# Intentsly

> Intentsly is a B2B sales platform that monitors LinkedIn, Reddit and X for buying signals, enriches the people behind them with verified emails, and runs AI-written LinkedIn and email outreach so teams book meetings with buyers who are already looking for what they sell.

## Product

- [Home](https://intentsly.com/): What Intentsly does and how it works
- [LinkedIn buying signals](https://intentsly.com/features/linkedin-signals): Find leads from LinkedIn posts, comments, job changes and competitor engagement
- [Reddit & X monitoring](https://intentsly.com/features/reddit-x-signals): Capture buying signals from Reddit and X conversations
- [AI SDR outreach](https://intentsly.com/features/ai-sdr): AI-written, signal-based LinkedIn and email outreach with follow-ups
- [Conversational AI](https://intentsly.com/features/conversational-ai): AI that replies to prospects and moves them towards a booked meeting
- [Pricing](https://intentsly.com/pricing): Plans and pricing

## Free tools and guides

- [LinkedIn Profile Analyzer](https://intentsly.com/linkedin-profile-analyzer): Free AI review of a LinkedIn profile
- [LinkedIn Hook Analyzer](https://intentsly.com/linkedin-hook-analyzer): Score a post's first line and get rewritten hooks
- [Buying Signal Finder](https://intentsly.com/buying-signals): How people asking for a service talk on LinkedIn
- [Cold Message Grader](https://intentsly.com/cold-message-grader): Grade a LinkedIn DM or cold email and get a rewrite
- [Try Intentsly AI](https://intentsly.com/try-ai): Describe who you sell to and get matching buyers
- [B2B playbook](https://intentsly.com/playbook): 0 to 100 customers in 90 days
- [Buying Signal Playbook](https://intentsly.com/signal-playbook): Spotting and acting on buying signals
